repairSummary: Updated row locator in cleanUpCreatedPage() to search by unique pageName within li.list-group-item instead of pageSlug.
Used exact delete button #btnPageDelete within the located row and handled Bootbox confirmation dialog (with alert fallback).
Ensured pageCreated flag is set immediately on save submission so teardown cleanup executes even if notification wait fails.
Asserted complete absence of the unique pageName after deletion, failing the test if cleanup fails.
assumptions: Admin credentials ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD are available as environment variables.
Admin static pages list at /admin/settings/pages renders page items inside li.list-group-item elements containing the pageName.
Bootbox confirmation modal contains button with standard data-bb-handler='confirm' or bootbox-accept / modal action classes.
